Behavioral review of `5dd5deb..HEAD`:

Finding (P1): correction-route navigation failures are not handled consistently. In [`src/app/sightings/$sightingId.tsx:427-435`](/home/kafka/code/costco-chicken-tracker/src/app/sightings/$sightingId.tsx:427), the Cancel button invokes the async `onCancel` directly, so a rejected `navigate()` becomes an unhandled promise rejection and the user receives no retryable error. The route already has `returnWithoutSaving()` specifically for this error handling, but the loaded-editor Cancel path bypasses it. The two capture correction buttons similarly invoke async navigation through `onClick={() => onOpenCorrection?.(...)}` ([`src/app/index.tsx:521`](/home/kafka/code/costco-chicken-tracker/src/app/index.tsx:521), [`:678`](/home/kafka/code/costco-chicken-tracker/src/app/index.tsx:678)); rejected navigation is unhandled there too. Wrap these callbacks in handlers that catch and expose a user-visible retry state.

Checks: `bun run lint` passed; `bun run typecheck` passed; focused capture/recent/correction tests passed (30 tests). `bun run check` is not a defined package script.

VERDICT: NOT READY
